unlisted_practices: Use AI-enhanced simulation as a complementary strategy in clinical training rather than a substitute for traditional clinical placements.
Conduct formal validation, reliability testing, and outcome comparisons of AI-supported objective structured clinical examinations in future studies.
Prepare faculty to be proficient with AI simulation technology and to conduct prebriefs, monitor learner engagement, and lead debriefings.
Provide stable network connectivity and designated sound-absorbing spaces for voice-based AI simulation sessions.

screen.reason: This is a viewpoint/reflective case report describing the implementation and operational insights of an AI-simulated patient for nursing education, explicitly noting that formal psychometric validation and outcome comparisons were not undertaken.
